criteria.name: success
criteria.check: Ready visibly reads as a check mark with asymmetrical arms conveying successful completion. No particular unequal-length recipe is mandatory.

criteria.name: readability
criteria.check: Silhouette and deliberate pixel clusters/edges remain readable at 1x and 3x nearest on #172336.

criteria.name: style

criteria.name: distinction
criteria.check: In both actual consumers at 1x and 3x, Ready is distinguishable from Working/activity, Retry and Paused without relying on color, including grayscale; collective appearance remains coherent.

criteria.name: consumer

criteria.name: production

criteria.name: preservation
